kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحايلت (form VI)
# تَحَايَلْتُ (taḥāyaltu) /ta.ħaː.jal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَايَلَ (taḥāyala)
# تَحَايَلْتَ (taḥāyalta) /ta.ħaː.jal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَايَلَ (taḥāyala)
# تَحَايَلْتِ (taḥāyalti) /ta.ħaː.jal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَايَلَ (taḥāyala)
# تَحَايَلَتْ (taḥāyalat) /ta.ħaː.ja.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
